verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a SaaS compliance platform, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents retention settings, deletion controls or data-purge capabilities. The GDPR framework support, disclosure-log template and MCP permission scoping cover other capabilities and do not show users controlling how long Thoropass keeps their data or deleting it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
